subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column.
stimulus: very kind to us. My school is located at a very nice place of the city. I like very excellent having three storey building. My class teacher has two small green plants on either side of the main gate. to go to school in the proper uniform.
guide_solution: (a) My school is located at a very nice place of the city. (b) My school is very excellent having three storey building. (c) My class teacher has two small green gardens near to the main gate. (d) I like to go to school in the proper uniform. (e) My class teacher is very kind to us.
